## Parental OpControl 0.17.20

- **Browser rules (Chrome, Edge and Brave).** The Websites page has a new **Browser rules** card. Turn on **Block YouTube Shorts** to block `youtube.com/shorts`, `www.youtube.com/shorts` and `m.youtube.com/shorts`, including subpaths. Regular videos, search and channels keep working. Add custom pages such as `x.com/i/grok` with a validated host and optional path. Rules are written only to the monitored child's own Windows account, never to the machine or to other users, and are removed cleanly when a rule is turned off or the client is uninstalled.
- **Policy protection.** The client re-applies the policy when the child signs in, when a rule changes and if the policy is removed. A **browser-policy-removed** tamper alert is raised when it has to restore the rules.
- **Firefox is not changed.** Firefox does not read user-level policy on Windows, so the product does not fall back to a machine-wide setting. The dashboard says which browsers are supported.
- **Block other browsers helper.** A one-click helper in the card adds normal blocked App rules for installed browsers that do not honor browser policy. It does nothing until a parent clicks.
- **Device came online.** Each device has a new **Notify me when this device comes online** switch (off by default). Reconnects shorter than five minutes are ignored. Push and email follow the parent's existing offline/connectivity preferences.
- Both laptops use the normal catalog update. The Shorts toggle stays off until Ziur turns it on.
